newsitem.title: UK: Shield sees conference helping AFT talks.
newsitem.headline: Shield sees conference helping AFT talks.

text.p: Shield Diagnostics Group Plc said on Thursday a recent conference would help it in ongoing collaborative talks with potential partners for its Activated Factor Twelve (AFT) test for heart attacks.

"I can confirm that these(collaborative talks on AFT) are progressing satisfactorily, as are our plans for the full commercialisation of AFT," Gordon Hall, managing director of the British diagnostic company said.
Shield presented data on the use of AFT to over 6000 delegates from 62 countries at the conference held in Florence, Italy, earlier this month.
By 1426 GMT, shares in the company had risen 20p to stand at 542-1/2p.
